sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Appliance capacity or size is not programmed. Invalid unit codes refer to the configuration flow chart. This is a critical alert.
diySteps: Leave the furnace off. This is a configuration fault

Technician: check the unit size codes for the furnace in the configuration guide or the installation instructions. The code clears after a valid unit code is read following a reset. The manual says to remove the thermostat from the system while applying power and reprogramming
proAdvice: E203 means no valid capacity code is programmed. It is not E202, which is a mismatch after a code has been selected. Call a licensed HVAC technician.
